commun.verset: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

accueil.titre: How is the fruit of the Spirit growing in your life?
accueil.lede: Take a moment to reflect on your Christian journey. Based on your answers, CHRISTOSMETRICS helps you recognise your strengths and the areas in which you would like to grow.

compte.titre: Create your account or sign in.
compte.description: Find your answers and results in your personal space.

parcours.description: Explore one aspect of the fruit in depth, or reflect on your relationship as a couple through all nine aspects.

reponses.description: With an Internet connection, each answer is saved. You can stop and come back later.

restitution.description: View your scores, charts and PDF report. Complete the six available individual assessments to unlock your overall summary.

accueil.aide: A tool for personal reflection based on your answers, to support your spiritual growth.
accueil.fruits_disponibles: Love, Joy, Peace, Patience, Goodness & Kindness, and Faithfulness.
accueil.fruits_a_concevoir: Gentleness and Self-control have yet to be developed.
accueil.cta_commencer: Create my account and get started

champs.regles_mot_de_passe: 8 to 100 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.

connexion.lede: Return to your assessments in progress and your results.

inscription.lede: Your account lets you save your answers and continue later.

parcours_couple.description: Reflect on the spiritual dynamics of your relationship through the nine aspects of the fruit. One statement per aspect.

individuel.titre: How is the fruit of the Spirit growing in your life?
individuel.lede: Choose an aspect of the fruit. View your results or resume a questionnaire in progress.

ecran1.pitch: Christosmetrics helps you see how the fruit of the Spirit is growing in your life, without judgement.

ecran2.pitch: Explore each aspect of the fruit with care. Complete all six to discover your overall CHRISTOS picture.

ecran3.titre: Take away a PDF, a plan and Bible verses.

progression.fruits_restants_one: Just 1 more assessment before your CHRISTOS summary
progression.fruits_restants_other: Just {{count}} more assessments before your CHRISTOS summary

rappels.description: Receive a notification inviting you to check in from time to time.
rappels.non_dispo: Notifications are unavailable in this environment. Try the mobile app or a compatible browser over HTTPS.
rappels.installer_ios: To receive reminders on iPhone or iPad, first install the app from Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from its icon (iOS 16.4 or later).
rappels.limite_web: On the Web, these local reminders require the app to stay open. They do not work once it is closed and may be delayed in the background. After reloading, reopen this profile to schedule them again.
rappels.permission_refusee: Notification permission has not been granted. Check your browser or phone settings before trying again.
rappels.regle_mensuelle: Monthly reminders fall on the first occurrence of your chosen weekday each month.
rappels.heure_locale: The time follows this device’s time zone. The system may delay notifications, especially in power-saving mode.
rappels.planifies: Your next 8 reminders are scheduled. They are renewed when you open this profile.
rappels.erreur: Unable to update reminders. Check permissions and try again.
rappels.stockage_indisponible: Preferences cannot be saved on this device. Turn reminders off before closing if you do not want to keep them.
rappels.test_planifie: Test scheduled in 10 seconds. Keep the app open for the Web test.
rappels.msg_debut: 🌱 Time for your Christosmetrics check-in. Which aspect of the fruit would you like to explore today?
rappels.msg_progression: 🌱 You’re on your way to your CHRISTOS summary. Ready for a check-in?
rappels.msg_christos_debloque: 🌟 Revisit your CHRISTOS summary and spend a moment reflecting on one aspect of the fruit.
rappels.msg_streak_fort: 🔥 A lovely streak! How about a brief check-in to keep it going?
rappels.msg_generique: 🌱 Take a few minutes for your spiritual journey.
